pictures.title: Merlin taketh the child Arthur into his keeping
pictures.caption: Of the birth of King Arthur and of his nurture.

pictures.title: The Lady of the Lake telleth Arthur of the sword Excalibur
pictures.caption: How Arthur by the mean of Merlin gat Excalibur his sword of the Lady of the Lake.

pictures.title: Merlin and Nimue
pictures.caption: How Merlin was assotted and doted on one of the ladies of the lake, and how he was shut in a rock under a stone and there died.

pictures.title: Arthur and the strange mantle
pictures.caption: How the Damosel of the Lake saved King Arthur from mantle that should have burnt him.

pictures.title: Lancelot and Hellawes
pictures.caption: How Sir Launcelot came into the Chapel Perilous and gat there of a dead corpse a piece of the cloth and a sword.

pictures.title: How Sir Tristram Drank of the Love Drink
pictures.caption: How Sir Tristram demanded La Beale Isoud for King Mark, and how Sir Tristram and Isoud drank the love drink.

pictures.title: How la Beale Isoud wrote to Sir Tristram
pictures.caption: How La Beale Isoud sent letters to Sir Tristram by her maid Bragwaine, and of divers adventures of Sir Tristram.

pictures.title: How King Marke found Sir Tristram
pictures.caption: How King Mark found Sir Tristram naked, and made him to be borne home to Tintagil, and how he was there known by a brachet.

pictures.title: How Morgan le Fay gave a Shield to Sir Tristram
pictures.caption: How Sir Dinadan rescued a lady from Sir Breuse Saunce Pité, and how Sir Tristram received a shield of Morgan le Fay.

pictures.title: Mark & Dinadan & Palomides
pictures.caption: How King Mark and Sir Dinadan heard Sir Palomides making great sorrow and mourning for La Beale Isoud.

pictures.title: La Beale Isould at Joyous Gard
pictures.caption: How Sir Tristram and La Beale Isoud came unto England, and how Sir Launcelot brought them to Joyous Gard.

pictures.title: How Sir Launcelot was known by Dame Elaine
pictures.caption: How Sir Launcelot was known by Dame Elaine, and was borne into a chamber and after healed by the Sangreal.

pictures.title: How a devil in Woman's likeness would have tempted Sir Bors
pictures.caption: How the devil in a woman’s likeness would have had Sir Bors to have lain by her, and how by God’s grace he escaped.

pictures.title: The Achieving of the Sangreal
pictures.caption: How they were fed with the Sangreal while they were in prison, and how Galahad was made king.

pictures.title: How Queen Guenever rode on Maying
pictures.caption: How Queen Guenever rode a-Maying with certain knights of the Round Table and clad all in green.

pictures.title: How Sir Bedivere Cast the Sword Excalibur into the Water
pictures.caption: How King Arthur commanded to cast his sword Excalibur into the water, and how he was delivered to ladies in a barge.

pictures.title: How Queen Guenever made her a Nun
pictures.caption: Of the opinion of some men of the death of King Arthur; and how Queen Guenever made her a nun in Almesbury.
